Package persist.lint.api.spi

package persist.lint.api.spi
Service Provider Interface (SPI) for build-time validation of named JPA objects.

This package defines the core abstractions used to parse and validate named JPQL queries and stored procedures at build time, without requiring a live database connection:

  • NamedObjectParser — parses and semantically validates a named JPQL query or stored procedure declaration against the project's entity metamodel.
  • NamedObjectParserFactory — factory for creating NamedObjectParser instances; implementations are discovered at runtime via the ServiceLoader mechanism.

Provider implementations for specific JPA namespaces are shipped in separate modules (e.g. lint-persistence-jakarta and lint-persistence-legacy).

Since:
2.0.0
